name: Godot Tech Art
responsibility: Owns the look and the frame budget of a Godot game — shaders, materials, environment, lighting, fog, glow, procedural geometry generation, and LOD strategy. Sits between art (which decides intent) and godot_dev (which drives uniforms from gameplay). Exists as its own role because shader and render work is a different discipline from gameplay scripting and is usually where a 3D game's time and its performance actually go. Owns the draw-call and fps numbers.

inputs.notes: Visual target and any named reference the look is chasing
Which phase the look is expected to land in
Screenshot and measure loop, and the debugging techniques. Read before touching a shader.
Palette and visual direction to implement
Which uniforms gameplay drives, and the scene structure to hang materials on

outputs.description: All shaders. Comments must record why a value is what it is — these are the values that get 'cleaned up' and break the look.
Shared shader includes. The single GPU copy of any function duplicated on the CPU.
Procedural mesh builders — ArrayMesh generation, LOD variants.
Uniform contract for godot_dev, plus measured fps/draw calls at the end of each phase.

merge.merge_when: Merged INTO godot_dev when the game uses stock materials and no custom shaders.
